videos.title: Meta’s Muse: Inside the launch of the most successful consumer product this year | Mona Sarantakos
videos.description: Muse is the #1 app in the App Store and arguably the fastest-growing AI consumer product of all time. Mona Sarantakos has led product on it since day one. She’s VP of Product at Meta Superintelligence Labs and a 10-year Meta veteran with over 20 years of experience as a PM. This is her first podcast
